defaultModel:
{{
  {
    rows: cpc_all_sources_per_job.data || [],
    history: history.data || [],
    limits: { min_cents: 5, max_cents: 300, max_multiplier: 5 },
    status: (cpc_all_sources_per_job.isLoading || history.isLoading)
      ? 'loading'
      : (cpc_all_sources_per_job.responseMeta && cpc_all_sources_per_job.responseMeta.error)
        ? 'error'
        : Array.isArray(cpc_all_sources_per_job.data)
          ? (cpc_all_sources_per_job.data.length ? 'ready' : 'empty')
          : 'idle',
    error: (cpc_all_sources_per_job.responseMeta && cpc_all_sources_per_job.responseMeta.error
             && cpc_all_sources_per_job.responseMeta.error.message)
        || (history.responseMeta && history.responseMeta.error
             && history.responseMeta.error.message)
        || ''
  }
}}
onSearch: {{ storeValue('cpc_job_id', (typeof eventData !== 'undefined' && eventData && eventData.jobId) || CpcOverrideTool.model.searchJobId).then(() => { cpc_all_sources_per_job.run(); history.run(); }) }}
